repo.description:
### Impact

On sites with category group moderation enabled, the review queue could include an excerpt (and permalink) of the private message attached to a flag, even when the reviewing category moderator was not a participant in that message. These notify_moderators flag messages are addressed only to moderators and, for core flags, to a category's moderation groups as they existed when the flag was raised, so a category group moderator could read flag-discussion content they were not authorized to see. This affects official plugins that create such messages and core flags raised before a moderator's group was granted moderation of the category. Only the confidentiality of a limited excerpt of these flag-related private messages is affected; no content can be modified or deleted.

### Patches
This issue is fixed in the latest release. Upgrade to the patched version.

### Workarounds
Until you can upgrade, disable the enable_category_group_moderation site setting: this removes category group moderators' access to the review queue and therefore the exposure. If category group moderation must remain enabled, ensure only fully trusted staff belong to your category moderation groups.
repo.summary: Review queue exposes flag-related private message excerpts to category group moderators
